scope: First command profile and all-library acceptance inventory; not a certification of current code.
source_mapping_note: Rust entries are candidate ownership evidence, not a disjoint import map. M0 must classify symbols in shared files (notably types.rs) and root reexports. New command modules are to be assigned during implementation.

cards.responsibility: Own signed atoms, canonical bytes, content identity, and set membership.

cards.upper_affordance: Expose strict codecs, verification, immutable set operations and vocabulary without receiver policy.
cards.bootstrap_and_capabilities: Canonical codecs, hashes and signature verification are declared intrinsics; no I/O or implicit trust selection.
cards.observable_state_and_reconstruction: Reconstruct a set from verified deltas; admission, authority and effect are not implied by set insertion.
cards.forbidden_semantics: No caller accounts, active operation registry, admission policy or upper-layer imports.
cards.first_delivery_success: Malformed duplicate appearances are checked at the intake boundary even when set insertion deduplicates early.
cards.later_portability_success: All existing Delta codecs and set laws remain portable; key custody remains a declared host capability.
cards.composition_target: Eligible for randomized language assignment only at a declared reconstructible contract port; report native unsplit regions until such a port exists.
